title: Understanding Physical Activity and Its Role in Weight Health

authorship.current_visible_author: Healthy Weight Literacy Foundation Editorial Team
authorship.recommended_normalized_author: Healthy Weight Literacy Foundation Editorial Team

primary_question: How does physical activity relate to weight health?
reader_intent: Get a general, accessible understanding of physical activity's role in weight health without unrealistic expectations.
desired_reader_outcome: Reader understands physical activity broadly supports health regardless of whether weight changes, and understands common barriers.

internal_link_recommendations.reason: Nearly identical reader job with more specific, citable detail.

disposition_reason: This reader job is almost entirely duplicated by physical-activity-for-health-beyond-weight-loss, which covers the same core message (activity benefits health regardless of weight change) with more specific, citable detail. Its distinct value — a clear, non-technical explanation of why exercise doesn't always produce expected weight loss — is worth preserving as a subsection of the survivor.
recommended_rewrite_scope: Fold the 'why exercise doesn't always lead to weight loss' explanation into the survivor article.
